sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 22/03/2023 The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of Fir
No.51/2022, Police Station Samdari, District Barmer for offences under Sections 341, 323, 420 and
506 of Ipc.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report received from the SHO, Police Station Samdari,
District Barmer wherein it has been mentioned that Police is going to submit a Final Report in this case.
The said report is hereby taken on record.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
Stay application also decided.
